H264 works well in most cases, but sometimes it's worth going for a different codec. WebM achieves higher compression but is slower to render. WebM, GIF and ProRes support transparency.

## CLI flag

Use `--codec` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                 | Flag              |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--codec <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)             | `--codec <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--codec <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--codec <value>` |
